name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand with one hand on a support and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lean back, bend your knees forward and lower your hips toward your heels while your torso stays in a straight line from knees to head.
Go as deep as you comfortably can.
Push through the toes to rise back up. This is hard on the knees, so go gradually.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with one hand holding a support and the heels raised.
